# keenetic-netcraze-manager

> Agent skill and CLI to manage Keenetic and Netcraze routers over RCI (the HTTP-JSON API
> of KeeneticOS). Read router state, manage `object-group fqdn` domain lists, configure
> DNS-based split tunneling, inspect access policies, and apply CLI commands with an
> automatic config backup.

## What this is

A Python 3 command-line client (`scripts/kn.py`) plus agent instructions (`SKILL.md`) for
working with Keenetic and Netcraze routers: KN-1010, KN-1012, KN-1810, KN-1811, KN-2710,
KN-3810 and other KN-series devices running KeeneticOS 4.x or 5.x.

## Key facts

- Authentication is the web-panel challenge, not HTTP Basic:
  `POST /auth` with `SHA256(challenge + MD5("login:realm:password"))`.
- A plain `GET /auth?login=…&password=…` always returns HTTP 401 — a common trap.
- Commands go through `POST /rci/ {"parse": "<single command>"}`; one line per request.
- CLI context (for example inside an `object-group`) persists across requests via the cookie.
- `GET /rci/show/version` returns the firmware version; `show running-config` returns the
  full configuration as a line array.
- Domain lists are `object-group fqdn <name>`; routing is
  `dns-proxy route object-group <name> <interface> auto`.
- Access policies are `ip policy <name>` with `permit` / `no permit` entries.

## Install

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills
git clone https://github.com/mkirillka/keenetic-netcraze-manager.git \
  ~/.agents/skills/keenetic-netcraze-manager
cd ~/.agents/skills/keenetic-netcraze-manager
python3 scripts/kn.py init
python3 scripts/kn.py doctor
```

## Commands

`init`, `routers`, `doctor`, `version`, `config`, `show`, `groups`, `domains`, `cli`,
`apply`, `save`, `notes`, `note`, `backups`.

## Constraints

- Python 3.8+, standard library only.
- No credentials in the repository: passwords come from the OS keyring or environment
  variables, addresses from a local profile at `~/.config/keenetic-skill/routers.json`.
- No NDSSO (cloud sign-in) support.
- Requires the local web panel (HTTP/HTTPS) to be reachable on the LAN.
